world.title: Hormuz Oil Exports Could Decline amid Inbound Tanker Shortage
world.summary: Oil exports from the Strait of Hormuz may decline due to a shortage of inbound tankers. Increased oil flows, primarily from ship-to-ship transfers in the Gulf of Oman, are causing supertankers to wait weeks for transfers outside the Strait. Despite a recovery in crude exports nearing pre-war levels, Brent Crude prices have recently decreased, reflecting market bearishness.

world.title: Trump pushes Iran war decision to 2027, says he will 'see what happens' after January 1
world.summary: US President Donald Trump announced on Thursday that he will postpone any decision regarding military action against Iran until after January 1, 2027. This statement indicates a halt in his plans for new attacks on Iran this year. Trump's remarks suggest a cautious approach to future military engagement, emphasizing a wait-and-see strategy in the coming years.

world.title: India votes in support of UNGA resolutions on Palestine
world.summary: India has voted in favor of four United Nations General Assembly resolutions regarding Palestine. These resolutions affirm the Palestinian people's right to self-determination, support the continuation of operations by the United Nations Relief and Works Agency (UNRWA), and uphold the property rights of Palestinian refugees. India's support reflects its ongoing commitment to addressing the Palestinian issue in international forums.

business.title: D-Street braces for gap-down opening on negative GIFT Nifty cues
business.summary: Indian equity benchmarks closed higher on Thursday after recovering from earlier losses. The Nifty 50 and BSE Sensex saw significant gains, driven by strong buying interest, particularly in auto stocks, which rose over four percent. Foreign portfolio investors actively purchased shares, while domestic institutional investors were net sellers, indicating mixed sentiment in the market ahead of a gap-down opening.

business.title: VMware patches vCenter zero-day exploited in attacks since September
business.summary: Broadcom has issued security updates to address a critical authentication bypass vulnerability in VMware vCenter Server, identified as CVE-2026-123890. This flaw has been exploited in zero-day attacks linked to Chinese hackers since September 2026. Users are urged to apply the patches promptly to mitigate potential risks associated with this vulnerability and enhance their system security.

business.title: Noel Tata to push alternative plan at Tata Sons board meeting
business.summary: Noel Tata intends to propose an alternative restructuring plan for Tata Sons at the board meeting on November 26. He seeks transparency on the Reserve Bank of India's listing requirements. Additionally, Tata Trusts are advocating for changes to maintain Tata Sons' unlisted status through mergers. A legal opinion indicates that compliance with RBI directives is essential, complicating the situation.

technology.title: Apple Recruits Engineering Chief for Autonomous AI Agent Built to Run Apps and Write Code
technology.summary: Apple is seeking a senior engineering manager to develop an autonomous AI assistant capable of writing and debugging code, browsing the web, and controlling applications. This initiative aims to create a proactive AI agent that can operate across devices on behalf of users. The recruitment effort reflects Apple's commitment to advancing AI technology in its product ecosystem.

technology.title: If tiny 'primordial' black holes exist, here's how we might find them
technology.summary: Scientists propose that tiny "primordial" black holes may have formed shortly after the Big Bang in dense regions that collapsed under gravity. If discovered, these black holes could significantly contribute to our understanding of dark matter, the elusive substance that constitutes most of the universe's mass. Their existence remains hypothetical, but research continues to explore potential detection methods.

technology.title: Advanced Electronic Materials Journal: Scope, OA
technology.summary: Advanced Electronic Materials is a fully open access journal published by Wiley-VCH, ISSN 2199-160X. It focuses on interdisciplinary research in electronic materials and their applications. The journal features a displayed impact factor and includes various review types. Due to the title's commonality, search results may yield mixed results, complicating the identification of this specific publication.

sports.title: De Villiers calls Usman Khawaja 'biggest traitor'; Cummins' captaincy faces threat as sandpaper shockwaves reverberate
sports.summary: Former South Africa captain Fanie de Villiers labeled Usman Khawaja the "biggest traitor ever seen" amid ongoing discussions about Australia's 2018 ball-tampering scandal. The controversy has raised questions about Pat Cummins' captaincy, as the fallout from the incident continues to affect Australian cricket. The remarks highlight the tensions surrounding the scandal and its implications for team leadership.

sports.title: Temba Bavuma scripts history, creates captaincy world record with Bangladesh Test win
sports.summary: Temba Bavuma has set a record for the most Test wins by a captain in their first 16 matches, achieving his 14th victory. This milestone was reached after South Africa defeated Bangladesh by nine wickets in a recent Test match. Bavuma's leadership has marked a significant achievement in cricket history, highlighting his successful start as captain.

sports.title: Lionel Messi fed up with Argentine football association and sets lawyers to work
sports.summary: Lionel Messi has ended his relationship with the Argentine Football Association (AFA) approximately six weeks after his last international match. According to A24 and journalist Nicolás Wiñazki, Messi's decision stems from dissatisfaction with various issues related to the AFA. The superstar has reportedly engaged lawyers to address these concerns, marking a significant shift in his involvement with Argentine football.

health.title: Delhi Lab's Analysis Flags Abnormal Health Findings Among Men Over 30
health.summary: A Delhi NCR diagnostic laboratory network reported a significant number of abnormal health findings in men over 30, emphasizing the importance of regular preventive health check-ups. Conditions like heart disease, diabetes, hypertension, and fatty liver often develop silently, making early detection crucial. The findings underscore the need for increased awareness and proactive health management among this demographic.

health.title: Bordetella pertussis adapts to human nasal mucosa through biofilm-associated virulence reprogramming and host-defense attenuation
health.summary: Bordetella pertussis adapts to human nasal mucosa by forming biofilms that enhance its virulence and resist antimicrobial peptides. Inoculated primary human nasal epithelial cultures showed Bp's robust adherence and replication, leading to altered host gene expression. Key findings include downregulation of vaccine-targeted virulence factors and mucociliary clearance genes, highlighting biofilms as significant in Bp transmission and potential vaccine development targets.

health.title: Petra Ibum Adjah։ Three Important Facts Concerning Cervical Cancer in Nigeria
health.summary: Petra Ibum Adjah from Pink Africa Foundation highlighted three key facts about cervical cancer in Nigeria. She emphasized the World Health Organization's 90-70-90 strategy aimed at eliminating cervical cancer in low- and middle-income countries by 2030. This includes vaccinating 90% of girls by age 15, screening 70% of women, and providing treatment for 90% of diagnosed cases.

science.title: A Black Hole Smaller Than an Atom Could Blow a Star Apart From Inside
science.summary: Physicists have discovered that a primordial black hole, smaller than an atom, could potentially explode a sun-like star from within. This explosion might produce a visible flash detectable by modern telescopes. The study, conducted by researchers at MIT and other institutions, presents a novel method for astronomers to search for dark matter through these cosmic events.

science.title: Experiments in Fluids Journal: Scope & Metrics
science.summary: Experiments in Fluids is a journal focused on experimental fluid mechanics, catering to researchers, mechanical engineers, aerospace scientists, and chemical engineers. It features a peer review workflow and emphasizes measurement techniques in the field. The journal has an impact factor of 2.7, highlighting its relevance and contribution to the scientific community in fluid dynamics research and applications.

science.title: Engineering Research Express: Scope and Guide
science.summary: Engineering Research Express (ERX), launched in 2019 by IOP Publishing, focuses on interdisciplinary applied science. The journal is indexed in Scopus and ESCI, ensuring visibility. It features peer review workflows, author submission guidelines, and article processing charge (APC) terms. ERX aims to facilitate the dissemination of research that crosses traditional departmental boundaries in modern technological projects.

entertainment.title: Actor Arjun slams alcoholic claims, marital discord reports about daughter Aishwarya
entertainment.summary: Actor Arjun Sarja has filed a complaint against reports alleging marital discord between his daughter, Aishwarya Sarja, and her husband, Umapathy Ramaiah. He condemned claims labeling Aishwarya as an 'alcoholic' and emphasized that public scrutiny does not justify baseless allegations or attacks on a woman’s dignity. Arjun seeks to protect his daughter's reputation from unfounded accusations.

entertainment.title: Capricorn Horoscope Today: November 20, 2026
entertainment.summary: On November 20, 2026, Capricorns may feel busy and unsupported. The horoscope suggests a need to reflect on recent efforts in collaboration and resource gathering. While hard work is acknowledged, there may be feelings of being uprooted. It’s a time to assess personal contributions and seek balance, ensuring that emotional needs are also addressed amidst ongoing commitments.

entertainment.title: Aries Horoscope Today: November 20, 2026
entertainment.summary: Aries individuals are experiencing a sense of celebration due to recent developments in their personal or professional lives, such as a birth, conception, or significant idea evolution. This period brings a reflective mood, highlighting accomplishments and milestones. The stars suggest that Aries should embrace these achievements while looking forward to future opportunities and growth in various aspects of life.
